test: MOB-01 typed host bridge supports async events cancellation and errors
assertions: Pigeon bootstrap snapshot crossed Kotlin and JNI into Rust ABI revision 1
started and cancelled events used the same operation identifier
a short operation emitted started and completed
a delay over 30000 milliseconds returned HOST_INVALID_DELAY
limitations: Android emulator feasibility evidence; physical Android and iOS device launch remain MOB-01 exit gates.
